what: A soundness flaw in the input check, found by trying to write its proof
severity: the check proves nothing against a node that substitutes two or more inputs

the_flaw.the_claim_the_code_made: zk/input_check.py: 'Deriving them from the commitments is what puts them after the inputs: a node that wants sum c_j e_j to vanish has to choose e before it can see c.'
the_flaw.why_it_is_wrong: The coefficients are derived from the DEALER'S commitments, which are published at dealing time. A node feeds the circuit later. So the node sees c before it fixes its input, and the quantifier the whole argument rests on is the wrong way round.
the_flaw.the_attack: Node p picks any k and feeds x_1 + c_2*k and x_2 - c_1*k. Then sum_j c_j e_j = c_1 c_2 k - c_2 c_1 k = 0 and the check accepts. No guessing, no probability: it works every time.
the_flaw.measured: verify_per_party accepted a two-input substitution with culprits = [] on the first try.
the_flaw.scope: Both the aggregate check and the per-party check. Everything built on top of them --- naming the substituting node, the identity chain, the end-to-end run --- inherits it. The Reed-Solomon decode in qomm_audit/locate.py is NOT affected; it does not depend on a challenge.

why_measurement_did_not_find_it: Every test substituted ONE input, and a single-input substitution really does need sum c_j e_j = 0 with one term, which forces e = 0. The attack needs two. Forty tests, six artifacts and an end-to-end run all passed because none of them tried the case the proof turned out to require.

the_fix.principle: The challenge has to be unpredictable at the moment a node fixes its input, and the input is fixed when the circuit reads it. So the challenge must come AFTER the input phase, not from anything published before it.
the_fix.construction: Open one random value inside the circuit after all inputs are read, and derive the coefficients from it as public arithmetic. Public times secret stays local, so the combination is still free; the cost is one opening.
the_fix.why_this_is_sound: The opened value is uniform and no single node can bias it under honest majority. A node that aborts and retries to resample it has to fix its error before each draw, so grinding costs 2^lambda attempts.
the_fix.what_it_does_not_need: It does not need a bulletin board or a beacon. Baum-Damgard-Orlandi take their challenges from the transcript for the same reason; this is the same discipline applied one layer down.

the_lesson: Six rounds of measurement, 585 tests and an end-to-end identity run did not find this. Writing the proof found it in one paragraph, at the step where the quantifier had to be made explicit. That is what a security proof is for, and it is the argument for writing one that this project had been treating as a formality.
